## Context / Problem
`AGENTS.md` says launch-loaded guidance must stay lean and point to maintained documentation, but its background-process section embeds a dated incident narrative, operator recovery procedure, and detector explanation. Every agent pays that context cost even when it only needs the prevention contract.

## Approach
- Replace the long `AGENTS.md` section with a compact prevention contract retaining the safety invariants, bounded-spawn and process-group cleanup example, bounded-LLM-gate exemption, and a detailed-documentation pointer.
- Move incident evidence, detector interpretation, and operator recovery into `docs/orphaned-processes.md`; index it from `docs/README.md`.
- Update both the module docstring and runtime report in `scripts/check_orphaned_load.py` to name `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- Assert that flagged-process runtime output contains `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- Preserve the commands and facts needed to prevent, detect, and reclaim orphaned processes.

## Scope
- `AGENTS.md`: compress the launch-loaded background-process rule.
- `docs/orphaned-processes.md`: own incident evidence, prevention rationale, detector interpretation, and operator recovery.
- `docs/README.md`: index the operations page.
- `scripts/check_orphaned_load.py`: replace both stale `AGENTS.md` recovery pointers.
- `tests/scripts/test_check_orphaned_load.py`: protect the runtime runbook reference.

## Testing
- Run `python scripts/check_docs_index.py`.
- Run focused documentation and orphan-detector tests.
- Run `make lint` with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- Verify every moved invariant, command, and runbook reference remains reachable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The `AGENTS.md` background-process section contains no more than 35 physical source lines.
- [x] The compact section includes a wall-clock-bounded spawn plus process-group cleanup example.
- [x] The compact section states that no spawned process may reach PPID 1 and that each subagent must reap its own helpers.
- [x] The compact section prohibits unbounded busy loops without a wall-clock bound.
- [x] The compact section explicitly forbids applying timeouts to bounded LLM gate operations.
- [x] Dated incident evidence is absent from `AGENTS.md` and present in `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [x] Orphan-detector interpretation and operator reclamation steps are absent from `AGENTS.md` and present in `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [x] The Operations section of `docs/README.md` links `orphaned-processes.md` as the prevention, detection, and recovery procedure.
- [x] The detailed page documents bounded spawn, process-group cleanup, read-only detection, and confirmed reclamation commands.
- [x] Both recovery pointers in `scripts/check_orphaned_load.py` name `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [x] A regression test proves flagged-process runtime output contains `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [x] Documentation checks and focused tests pass.
- [x] `make lint` passes with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- [x] [non-codebase] Gerrit reports `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and no unresolved comments.
- [x] [non-codebase] The change is submitted to `main`.

## Verification
Count physical source lines from the background-process H2 heading through the line before the next H2; search for every preserved invariant, command, and runbook reference; run focused tests and lint; then confirm Gerrit labels and merged status before closing the ticket.
